a.lede: Your Apple Watch doesn't need frequent restarts like a computer, but you might still want to shut down when something's off.
a.title: How often should you restart your Apple Watch?

b.lede: There are various ways to silence your Apple Watch when you need to lock in. Theater Mode doesn't quite go as far as Do Not Disturb, but it's still very useful.
b.title: What is Theater Mode on your Apple Watch and when should you use it?
